diseases.etiology: Hiperplasia / adenoma / adenokarsinoma kelenjar adrenal, akibat neutering dini + siklus cahaya artifisial
clinical_signs: Alopesia simetris bilateral (dari ekor ke depan)
diseases.prognosis: Baik dengan terapi medis, 2-4 tahun survival; guarded jika karsinoma metastatik
references: Fox JG. 2014. Ferret medicine and surgery. 3rd Edition. Wiley-Blackwell

diseases.etiology: Tumor sel beta pankreas menghasilkan insulin berlebihan menyebabkan hipoglikemia kronis
diseases.diagnostic_gold_standard: Glukosa darah puasa <60 mg/dL + kadar insulin tinggi
references: Peterson ME. 2018. Insulinoma in ferrets: diagnosis and management. Journal of Exotic Pet Medicine

diseases.etiology: Neoplasma limfosit, etiologi tidak diketahui, kemungkinan viral + genetik
diseases.diagnostic_gold_standard: Fine Needle Aspiration (FNA) + sitologi / biopsy histopatologi
treatment: Kemoterapi CHOP protocol (Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, Prednisolone)
references: Kiupel M et al. 2011. Classification of lymphoma in ferrets. Veterinary Pathology

diseases.etiology: Parvovirus infeksi kronis, autoimun kompleks imun
diseases.treatment: Tidak ada terapi spesifik, hanya suportif
diseases.prognosis: Buruk, fatal dalam 2-24 bulan pasca infeksi
references: Fox JG. 2014. Ferret medicine and surgery. 3rd Edition. Wiley-Blackwell
